title: webhooks.type_info
description: Catalogue lookup (BE-WH-7, BE-WH-11): for a configured event name (one of the 75 names of chapter 12 section 3, in scope or at the chapter 14 boundary; the names used in endpoint filters and to request an emission), the webhook_type string actually emitted in the payload and the payload's object_type key; `configured` tells whether the name is among the configured filterable names (true for every known name). Unknown names -> error unknown_event_type (field event).
